rubric.role_summary: Mid-to-senior robotics application engineer designing and prototyping tooling and integration hardware, developing robot-learning and data-collection strategies, and delivering customer robot deployments.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Mid-to-senior robotics application engineer designing and prototyping tooling and integration hardware, developing robot-learning and data-collection strategies, and delivering customer robot deployments.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related field
- 3+ years of experience in mechanical design for robotics, automation, manufacturing, or industrial systems
- CAD proficiency in SolidWorks, OnShape, or equivalent
- Experience designing grippers, tooling, fixtures, or electromechanical assemblies
- Hands-on prototyping experience involving 3D printing, machining, fabrication, or assembly
- Experience debugging robotic systems
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience working with robotic arms or humanoid systems
- Hands-on experience with robot policy training, fine-tuning, or deployment
- Experience integrating conveyors, AMRs, actuators, sensors, and other electromechanical devices
- Experience supporting real-world deployments or field installations
- Experience coordinating external contractors or vendors for fabrication or integration
- Familiarity with AI/ML concepts as applied to robotics
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
